summary.text: Jeff Mursau is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 36, who took office in 2005, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against independent Shena Chapman.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey Mursau has worked as an electrical contractor, restaurant owner and small business owner.
Before his election to the Assembly, he served as president of the Crivitz Village from 1991 to 2004.
For 2025-2026 he chairs the Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation Committee and also sits on the Agriculture, Education, Sporting Heritage and Tourism committees.
